description: Repairs r-sql-2-3/act-fail-insert-required: the description said T from T2 but the statement ran T2 from T2. Asks the required-field failure of INSERT ... SELECT from another table, as described: T2 holds four rows (R 'r'); INSERT INTO T3 (ID, V, U, S, W, R) SELECT ID + 10, V, U + 10, S, W, IIf(ID = 2, Null, R) FROM T2 without options into the empty T3, and the same into the empty T4 with dbFailOnError. RecordsAffected, Errors and the rows are read after each. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
